Status: Wave 260 accepted (6.3): ZipContainerStore, Operations.StoreUpdate, Operations.Trades and Operations.BusInterfaces

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. Four namespaces in one wave: ZipContainerStore (the zip backed product, baggage, data, master data, image and text stores), Operations.StoreUpdate (the buildings/building-part and bus interface XML patchers and the device template store update), Operations.Trades (the add, copy, delete and move trade operations) and Operations.BusInterfaces (the link and unlink group address operations).
Method.themes: The zip stores read and write entries directly (IZipEntry.AsStream, ZipWrapper.AddEntry/RemoveEntry) and the trade and bus interface operations repeat the collection conventions the earlier waves established (CreateValidators, AddToRecentGroupAddresses, CollectAssociationsToRemove, CreateAssociationTuple); MoveTradeOperation logs 'Moving trades'; the image store's iterator is <GetPriorisedFallbackIconPaths>d__6.
